$comment: ADR 0040 §2.1: this root manifest IS the Host-Edge package. cloud/ is an independently installed nested package with its own manifest, and npm workspaces stay forbidden — hoisting would let a Cloud-only driver satisfy an Edge import, so the isolation proof would pass for the wrong reason. Dependencies are the MEASURED external imports of the Edge tree, not an inherited copy of neomjs/neo's list. better-sqlite3 is declared under protest: four Edge-dispositioned scripts import it directly, which violates the host-plane property ai/services.host.mjs exists to hold. Declaring it keeps the tree installable while the mis-disposition is ruled on (neomjs/neo#17787); omitting it would have hidden a plane defect behind a module-resolution error.
